stories.title: Lindy Duncan Wins The ANNIKA at Pelican Golf Club (Tier 1 — FOLLOW UP)

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
LINDY DUNCAN WINS. 🏆

222 career starts. 35 years old. Zero wins before today.

She closes at 16-under at Pelican Golf Club, winning The ANNIKA by two over Hye-Jin Choi.

Oldest first-time LPGA winner since 2008.

#LPGA #TheANNIKA

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Lindy Duncan turned pro in 2013.

She spent 13 years grinding on tour, lost her card, regained it, and kept going.

Today, in her 222nd career start, she won. $487,500 from a $3M purse.

Worth every mile.

#LPGA #TheANNIKA #GolfFanrecap

article.headline: Lindy Duncan Wins The ANNIKA in Her 222nd Career Start, Oldest First-Time LPGA Winner Since 2008

stories.title: RSM Classic Preview — PGA Tour Season Finale at Sea Island Nov 19-22 (Tier 2 — NEW)

x_posts.label: Post 4-1
x_posts.text:
The RSM Classic at Sea Island starts Thursday.

$7.4M purse. 500 FedExCup Fall points. The final tournament before the 2027 season.

For players on the bubble, it's the last chance to lock up their card.

Sea Island. November 19-22.

#PGATour #RSMClassic

x_posts.label: Post 4-2
x_posts.text:
Sea Island is one of the most unique venues on the PGA Tour.

Many players live there year-round — which typically means a stronger field than usual for a Fall event.

The RSM Classic. This Thursday. The final act of the 2026 PGA Tour season.

#PGATour #RSMClassic #SeaIsland

article.headline: RSM Classic at Sea Island Is the PGA Tour's Season Finale — Cards, Points, and Pride on the Line

stories.title: LIV Golf Bankruptcy — Player Futures in Flux (Tier 2 — FOLLOW UP)

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
LIV Golf owes players $45M+.

Jon Rahm — the 2026 LIV individual champion — is reportedly owed $100M+.

Next court date: November 24.

The PGA Tour won't reinstate anyone until the bankruptcy process is complete.

What happens next is anyone's guess.

#LIVGolf #GolfNews
